summary: Edge proxy with seeded 50–300 ms WAN jitter and rotating CSP nonces in front of an app whose background worker emits SSRF, XXE and blind-SQLi callbacks 15–30 s after the HTTP response, plus a signature-optional billing webhook.

findings.title: Blind SQL injection in catalog search resolved asynchronously
findings.impact: boolean structure reaches the database and drives an out-of-band job; response bodies are identical
evidence: injected and benign responses are byte-identical; only the async callback differs

findings.title: Integration tester fetches attacker URLs after the response (async SSRF)
findings.impact: loopback/internal URL is fetched 15–30 s later, escaping synchronous SSRF filters
evidence: 202 returned with no callback evidence; collector records the fetch afterwards

findings.title: XML preview resolves external entities in a background worker
findings.impact: external entity URL is contacted after the 202, enabling internal file/HTTP exfiltration
evidence: DOCTYPE SYSTEM entity produces a delayed collector hit

findings.title: Billing webhook accepts unsigned events
findings.impact: unauthenticated caller credits invoices while a wrong signature is rejected
evidence: no X-Webhook-Signature header -> credited=true with synthetic credit canary
a supplied token schedules an out-of-band delivery after the response

chains.title: Async out-of-band exfiltration chain
chains.description: Three independent async jobs reach the same external collector after their HTTP responses, defeating synchronous-only verification.
